about: The places (docs/plan.md slice 51, "Places"; Rapha, 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21): where the player trains, as the engine reads it, a name, a glyph, the equipment and the three switches. One list for every surface: both phones, both watches (which show the place in use and never edit) and the desktop app bundle or build in this file; the game keeps one setup, which is Home. A place is {id, template, name, glyph, gear, floor, space, quiet}: `id` the template's own for a place the seeding made (so two devices that seed alike agree), else, for every place the player adds, from a template or empty, `p-` and 8 lower-case hex digits the device draws (another when the list holds it); `template` the template it came from, absent for an empty one; `name` absent while it is the template's words (`words`, a key of contract/copy/en.json, shown in the device's language), else the player's own, 1 to `place_name_max` Unicode scalars once trimmed; `glyph` one of `glyphs` (a piece of contract/design/art, drawn in text2 in the Row's KindTile); `gear` keys of contract/sheet.json's `gear`, kept in its `gear_order` (a key the device does not know, a newer device's equipment, is kept and passed on and filters nothing); `floor`, `space` and `quiet` the switches Floor moves, Room to move and Quiet mode (sheet.json's words of those keys). The engine's profile takes the place in use's gear and three switches, the same four fields it reads today, so no filter changes. Home is always the list's first, `id` home, its name and glyph fixed (the template's words and glyph: the game calls its one setup Home), never deleted; the others are the player's to rename, give another glyph, change, add (from a template or empty: `empty`) and delete (after the place's own confirm in the window, never a system alert), and to drag into another order after Home; at most `places_max` places with Home. Seeding: once, on a device that holds no places, the list is the templates in this order, Home taking the device's setup as it stands (its gear and three switches: the phones' and the desktop app's free-mode profile, so a player's setup carries over), every other template its own gear and switches here, and Home is in use. The place in use stays each device's own and never travels: picking a place on the setup's place button, Start a pump's place row or Your setup's place section makes it the place in use for every pump the device starts until the player picks another; a device whose place in use left the list (deleted here or on another device) takes Home. Home's gear and switches travel as the body exchange's `home` field between the game, the computer and the phones, the other places as `places` (the list without Home, the place in use not named) between the phones and the computer only (contract/companion-api.yaml, `Body`); a device that does not know them ignores them. No template ticks the stable chair or the sturdy table: a hotel's or an office's chair rolls and its desk tips (docs/safety.md hazards 4 and 18), so the player ticks them for a chair and a table that hold. A template's words are places.template.<id>, a glyph's places.glyph.<the glyph less place_>. tools/copytext.py --check fails on a template or a glyph without its words, a gear key outside gear_order or out of its order, a switch that is not a boolean, an id or a glyph named twice, a glyph contract/design/art lacks, words for no template or glyph, a Home that is not the first template, and limits that are not whole numbers above 1. The plan (2026-11-03, Rapha: "you can set one as default ... you can also have a schedule for the locations. e.g. Monday 18-20 you set it to gym"): {default, times}, `default` the id of the place in use whenever no time applies (Home at first; a default that left the list is Home), `times` at most `schedule_max` entries {days, from, to, place}: `days` the ISO weekdays it runs on (1 Monday to 7 Sunday, each once, at least one), `from` and `to` minutes after local midnight (0-1439, never equal; a `to` before `from` runs past midnight into the next day, the span belonging to the day it starts), `place` a place's id. The plan travels with the list as the body exchange's `place_plan` (contract/companion-api.yaml, `Body`), between the phones and the computer only. The place in use at a moment is each device's own: the place the player last picked on this device, while that pick was made at or after the schedule's latest start or end and the plan's last change (the stamp of `place_plan`: a new default or a changed time starts from the plan; a pick holds until the schedule's next start or end, the plan's next change or the next pick); else the place of the time running now (of two that overlap, the one that started later, then the later in the list); else the default; a place named there that left the list falls through to the next rule, and Home is the last. Seeding and an older device's place in use become a pick made at that moment.
